description: Serverless Containers takes secret environment variables as a `map<string, string>` of plaintext values on CreateContainer / UpdateContainer / CreateNamespace / UpdateNamespace (https://www.scaleway.com/en/developers/api/serverless-containers/), with no sensitive mark. The map shapes are marked sensitive; generate.ts emits their values as `string | Redacted<string>` (the protocol unwraps Redacted before sending). Response-side maps are left alone: core does not redact record values on decode, so marking them would type values as Redacted that arrive as strings.
